summary: A boutique Sydney agency with a clear voice appears to lose owners to missing proof and an appraisal button with no form.

findings.problem: The page promises a complimentary appraisal, but only a Book Appraisal button appears, with no visible form.
findings.cost: Owners ready to ask for a price must work to do it, and many will not.
findings.fix: A short appraisal form on the homepage.

findings.problem: The nav appears to list Testimonials and Meet Our Team, but no testimonials or team section appears on the page.
findings.cost: Owners choose an agent they can see and trust.
findings.fix: Real testimonials, sold results and a team section.

findings.problem: Only one phone number appears, once, and no business address appears in the page text.
findings.cost: Owners cannot easily call or confirm you are local.
findings.fix: Phone and address in the header and footer.

findings.problem: The Buy section appears to say you are building your portfolio, and the rent text says Marsfield and Punchbowl while a Rouse Hill listing appears.
findings.cost: Placeholder and mismatched text weakens a premium brand.
findings.fix: Clear sale results and consistent copy.
